# PHI/DUA scanner ratchet baseline.
#
# CRITICAL findings are never baselined -- they fail immediately and cannot be
# grandfathered. Only HIGH (hygiene) findings are counted here.
#
# This number may only go DOWN. If a change raises it, the nightly fails and
# names the new finding. Lowering it is the point: fix a personal path, drop
# the count, tighten this file.
#
# As seeded 2026-08-15: 60 pre-existing findings, all HIGH, none a disclosure.
#   ~57  absolute personal paths in R/ and scripts/ (leak a username, the
#        external-drive name "MufflySamsung", and local directory layout)
#     3  tracked files over 10MB (MCBS SFPUF x2, NAMCS 2019) -- public-use
#        survey data, deliberately committed, bloats a public clone
#
# Draining this backlog means routing those paths through R/core-paths.R
# (config/paths.yml) instead of hardcoding them.
#
# 2026-08-23: fell to 55 as a side effect of the CHIA runtime-artifact
# remediation (removing 480 tracked files under tests/testthat/artifacts/
# chia_*/ also removed some HIGH absolute-personal-path matches inside them),
# not a deliberate personal-path fix. Tightened per the scanner's own
# instruction rather than left stale.
high=55
